info.title: flora API
info.description: Manages @Flora guild deployments, User Bots, Server Custom Bots, authentication, builds, secrets, key-value stores, logs, and operator orchestration.

get.description: Validates the OAuth state cookie, exchanges the Discord authorization code, creates a flora session, sets the session cookie, and redirects to the dashboard. Invalid, mismatched, or expired state is rejected.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Opaque state value returned by Discord

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Creates a short-lived OAuth state value, stores it in a secure cookie, and redirects the browser to Discord. The callback must return the same state value before a flora session is created.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns the Discord identity associated with the current session or API token. Session-only profile fields may be empty when authentication uses a long-lived API token.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

post.description: Queues a server-side build for the provided project archive.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns the current status, logs, and artifacts for a build.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Streams build output as Server-Sent Events until the upstream build stream closes. The authenticated caller must have access to the build's guild or User Bot scope.

200.description: Server-Sent Event stream containing build output

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns every User Bot owned by the authenticated user, including deployment and gateway status. The User Bots feature must be enabled for the account.

200.description: User Bots owned by the authenticated user

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

post.description: Validates a Discord bot token, encrypts it at rest, and creates a User Bot owned by the authenticated user. The plaintext token is never returned. A deployment must be uploaded separately before the gateway starts.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns metadata and runtime status for a User Bot owned by the authenticated user. Tokens and other encrypted credentials are never included.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

delete.description: Stops the User Bot gateway, removes its active deployment, and deletes its encrypted token metadata. The operation is restricted to the owning user.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns the active deployment source and bundle for a User Bot owned by the authenticated user. Returns a not-found problem when the bot has not been deployed.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

post.description: Builds or accepts the supplied bundle, atomically replaces the User Bot isolate, records a deployment revision, and starts its Discord gateway. If deployment fails, the previous runtime and persisted deployment are restored.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns all deployment snapshots the authenticated user has access to.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns the latest successful deployment snapshot for a guild.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

post.description: Creates or updates the active deployment for a guild, then records a revision.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns deployment revisions for a guild in reverse chronological order.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns details for a specific deployment revision.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

post.description: Deploys a previous successful revision and records a new rollback revision.

parameters.name: revision_id
parameters.description: Successful revision ID to rollback to

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns Discord guilds where the authenticated user has Administrator or Manage Server permission and @Flora is currently installed. Requires an interactive Discord session.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns a lightweight liveness response when the HTTP process is accepting requests. This endpoint does not verify Discord, database, cache, or worker readiness.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

post.description: Creates a backup of all stores for a guild and returns a backup ID.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns all key-value stores for the specified guild.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

post.description: Creates a new key-value store for the specified guild.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

delete.description: Deletes a store and all stored keys.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns keys in a store. Use cursor for pagination when list_complete is false.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns the stored value or null when the key is missing.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

put.description: Creates or replaces a value in the store. Optional expiration controls TTL.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

delete.description: Deletes a key from the store if it exists.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns recent log entries for a specific guild.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (default 100, max 1000).

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Streams new runtime log entries as Server-Sent Events. The caller must manage the guild or own the addressed User Bot runtime scope. Existing entries are available from the non-streaming logs endpoint.

parameters.name: guild_id
parameters.description: Guild ID or User Bot runtime scope ID

200.description: Server-Sent Event stream containing runtime log entries

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns runtime metrics in Prometheus exposition format. Requires the configured operator bearer token and is intended for monitoring infrastructure.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns the current runtime metrics snapshot as JSON. Requires the configured operator bearer token and is intended for operator diagnostics.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns the active trusted orchestrator deployment. Only the configured Discord operator may access this endpoint; the deployment may contain sensitive feature-policy source.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

post.description: Validates and atomically replaces the trusted orchestrator isolate, persists a deployment revision, and immediately reconciles User Bot and Server Custom Bot gateways against the new feature policy. A failed deployment leaves the previous orchestrator active.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

delete.description: Removes the trusted orchestrator deployment and restores deny-by-default feature authorization. Existing User Bot and Server Custom Bot gateways are reconciled immediately without deleting their encrypted configuration.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns metadata for all secrets stored for a guild. Values are never returned.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

put.description: Creates or updates a secret value for a guild and refreshes the runtime.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

delete.description: Deletes a secret and refreshes the runtime to remove it.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns the Server Custom Bot configured for a guild, or null when the guild uses @Flora. The caller must manage the guild and the feature must be enabled by the orchestrator.

200.description: Configured Server Custom Bot, or null when none is configured

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

put.description: Validates that the supplied Discord bot token can access the guild, encrypts the token at rest, and routes the guild's existing flora deployment through that identity. Repeating the request replaces the token and gateway while preserving the guild deployment.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

delete.description: Stops the guild-owned gateway, deletes its encrypted token metadata, and returns the guild's existing deployment to @Flora. The caller must manage the guild.

200.description: Server Custom Bot removed and @Flora restored

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

get.description: Returns metadata for all API tokens owned by the authenticated user.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

post.description: Creates a new API token for the authenticated user. The plaintext token is returned only once.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

delete.description: Deletes the specified token. Requests using this token stop authenticating immediately.

default.description: The request failed. Inspect the HTTP status and Problem Details response for recovery guidance.

AuthUser.description: API representation of the authenticated user.

entry.description: Entry file path used for the build.

error.description: Error detail when the build fails.

CreateBuildResponse.description: Response returned when a build is created.

token.description: Discord bot token. The token is validated, encrypted, and never returned.

DeploymentResponse.description: Deployment snapshot stored for a guild.

bundle.description: Bundled output when stored, if included.

entry.description: Entry file path used for the deployment.

files.description: Raw files when the deployment was uploaded as sources.

oneOf.description: Source map included with the bundle, if provided.

GuildResponse.description: Guild info exposed by the API.

LogEntry.description: A log entry captured from the runtime.

level.description: Log level (trace, debug, info, warn, error).

timestamp.description: Timestamp in milliseconds since Unix epoch.

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (default 100, max 1000).

MetricsSnapshot.description: Snapshot of metrics at a point in time.

detail.description: Actionable explanation of this specific failure occurrence.

instance.description: Request path identifying where this failure occurred.

request_id.description: Correlation identifier also returned in the `X-Request-ID` header.

status.description: HTTP status code returned for this failure occurrence.

title.description: Stable, human-readable summary of the failure category.

type.description: Stable relative URI identifying the category of failure.

field.description: Identifies the invalid request field using its JSON or parameter path.

message.description: Explains how to correct the invalid field.

RawKvKeyInfo.description: Information about a single KV key.

expiration.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when this key expires.

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata attached to the key.

SecretMetadataResponse.description: Metadata response; values are never returned.

expiration.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the key expires, or null for no expiry.

metadata.description: Optional JSON metadata attached to the key.

TokenResponse.description: Token metadata returned for list endpoints.

label.description: Optional user-facing label for the token.

last_used_at.description: Last usage time in RFC3339 (UTC), if available.

token.description: Discord bot token. It is validated, encrypted, and never returned.
